The issuer shows high leverage with shareholders’ equity of about 15% of total assets (equity/assets ≈ 1,997/13,067) and liabilities exceeding equity by over 5x (liabilities/equity ≈ 10,429/1,997). Despite this, profitability appears solid with a healthy net income margin (~242/1,264 ≈ 19%), which partially offsets the balance-sheet pressure but still points to a weaker credit profile.  

DECISION: BB-
